title: Melody of the Spring Dance of Peaceful Hearts (Ka Sur Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem)
khasi_title: Ka Sur Ka Shad Suk Mynsiem
cultural_context: The festive liturgical song accompanying the national Khasi spring thanksgiving dance (Shad Suk Mynsiem) celebrated at Weiking, from Sweetymon Rynjah's landmark 2000 book.

khasi: Ha ka por pyrem haba ki syntiew ki phuh,
Ngi wan sha madan Weiking ba kyntang;
Ban ai nguh ia U Blei Nongthaw Nongbuh,
Ia ka snem ba la leit bad ka sngi ba la rung;
Ki thei-sotti ki phong ka dhara ba itynnad,
Ki samla ki bat ka waitlam bad ka stieh;
Ka ksing ka sawa pynkhie mynsiem,
Ha ka Shad Suk Mynsiem ba kmen.
english: In springtime when all highland blossoms flower,
We gather at the sacred arena of Weiking;
To offer thanksgiving unto God the Supreme Creator,
For the bounties of the past year and the blessings ahead;
Virtuous maidens don resplendent silk dharas,
Valiant youths wield the double-edged sword and shield;
The drumbeats thunder, awakening the soul,
In the joyful Dance of Peaceful Hearts.

khasi: Ka jingsuk mynsiem dei ka spah bakordor,
Ba u Blei u la theh ha ka ri;
Wat la ngi iaid ha ki lynti ba kylliang,
Ngin bat ia kane ka akor ba bha;
To rwai, to shad, ko khun u Hynniewtrep,
Ha ryngkat ka kmen ba shisha,
Ba ka burom jong ka ri Khasi
Kan im ha man ka jingshai.
english: Peace of heart is the most priceless treasure,
Which God has poured down upon our homeland;
Though our footsteps travel changing paths,
We shall uphold this noble decorum;
Sing on, dance on, children of the Seven Huts,
In harmony of genuine spiritual delight,
So that the majesty of the Khasi realm

vocabulary.shad suk mynsiem: the dance of peaceful hearts (annual spring thanksgiving)
vocabulary.dhara: traditional golden-yellow pure mulberry silk saree/wrap
vocabulary.weiking: historic sacred arena of the annual Shad Suk Mynsiem in Shillong
